turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil from Mumbai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Patil. Who is calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Rohan from the RBI regional compliance wing. Sir, we noticed your bank KYC has been pending since last month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: KYC? I thought I did that at the branch last year.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There is a new digital mandate, Mr. Patil. If we don't update it now, your account will be frozen by tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Frozen? But I have a payment of twenty five thousand rupees to make for my medicines tomorrow.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Exactly, that is why I am calling to help you avoid that trouble. I just need to verify your identity quickly.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, what do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please tell me your full Aadhaar number first, and then I will send a verification code to your phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Aadhaar number over the phone? Is that safe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am an official from the Reserve Bank. Just give me the number and the OTP I send you, otherwise the account will block.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am not sure, let me ask my son first.
